answer: RoG 把关系路径当作受知识图谱约束的计划：先由规划模块生成关系路径作为“faithful plans”，再从 KG 中检索有效推理路径供 LLM 推理，从而“retrieve the latest knowledge from KGs but also consider the guidance of KG structure for reasoning and explanations” [E1]；形式上以生成关系路径 z 的计划概率与给定 z、G 的答案概率相乘来刻画 [E6]；并称该框架生成“faithful and interpretable reasoning results” [E3]。MindMap 则以提示流程让 LLM 理解 KG 输入并“consolidates the retrieved facts from KGs and the implicit knowledge from LLMs”、在输入 KG 中发现新模式、再在 mind map 上推理 [E2]；其所谓 mind map 是“reveals their reasoning pathways based on the ontology of knowledge” [E7]，结论称可借图表示的 rationale 生成答案 [E9]。因此隐式知识在 MindMap 中被显式纳入与外部 KG 事实结合的推理 [E2]，而 RoG 的表述侧重将 KG 结构蒸馏进 LLM 以生成受图约束的计划、再检索路径推理 [E1]；MindMap 还主张让 LLM 同时利用外部与隐式知识可获更准确答案，并批评纯检索方法可能过度依赖外部知识 [E4]。可解释性边界：RoG 的“faithful and interpretable”是在其两个 KGQA 基准实验条件下得出的主张 [E1]；MindMap 的透明性主张来自三个医疗 Q&A 数据集及不匹配 KG 知识设定下的实验 [E9, E10]。原文未提供二者在相同数据划分、底座模型与解释质量协议下的对照，故不能据此断言一方解释更可信或二者结论可互相外推；两文亦未给出统一的“可解释性”度量定义 [E4, E10]。

Conclusion
This paper introduced knowledge graph (KG)
prompting that 1) endows LLMs with the capabil-

LLMs inferring with a combined implicit knowl-

evidence.quote:
ABSTRACT
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abili-
ties in complex tasks. However, they lack up-to-date knowledge and experience
hallucinations during reasoning, which can lead to incorrect reasoning processes
and diminish their performance and trustworthiness. Knowledge graphs (KGs),
which capture vast amounts of facts in a structured format, offer a reliable source
of knowledge for reasoning. Nevertheless, existing KG-based LLM reasoning
methods only treat KGs as factual knowledge bases and overlook the importance
of their structural information for reasoning. In this paper, we propose a novel
method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs with KGs to
enable faithful and interpretable reasoning. Specifically, we present a planning-
retrieval-reasoning framework, where RoG first generates relation paths grounded
by KGs as faithful plans. These plans are then used to retrieve valid reasoning
paths from the KGs for LLMs to conduct faithful reasoning. Furthermore, RoG
not only distills knowledge from KGs to improve the reasoning ability of LLMs
through training but also allows seamless integration with any arbitrary LLMs dur-
ing inference. Extensive experiments on two benchmark KGQA datasets demon-
strate that RoG achieves state-of-the-art performance on KG reasoning tasks and
generates faithful and interpretable reasoning results1.

OPTIMIZATION FRAMEWORK
Despite the advantage of generating relation paths as plans, the LLMs have zero knowledge of the
relations contained in KGs. Therefore, LLMs cannot directly generate relation paths grounded by
KGs as faithful plans. Moreover, LLMs might not understand the reasoning paths correctly and
conduct reasoning based on them. To address these issues, we design two instruction tuning tasks:
1) planning optimization, which distills the knowledge from KGs into LLMs to generate faithful
relation paths as plans; 2) retrieval-reasoning optimization, which enables LLMs to reason based on
the retrieved reasoning paths.

raw: {"premise_check":[{"premise":"MindMap 构建并使用 mind map，融合 KG 检索事实与 LLM 隐式知识进行推理","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E2","E7","E9"],"note":"E2 明确列出整合检索事实与隐式知识、发现模式、在 mind map 上推理三步"},{"premise":"RoG 通过生成受 KG 约束的关系路径计划，再从 KG 检索推理路径进行推理","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E1","E3","E6","E8"],"note":"E1/E3 的 planning-retrieval-reasoning 描述；E6 给出关系路径作为 plan 的形式化"},{"premise":"可解释性结论可在两篇论文间直接比较或存在统一边界","supported":false,"evidence_eids":["E1","E2","E4","E10"],"note":"两文任务与数据不同（RoG 为两个 KGQA 基准，MindMap 为三个医疗 Q&A 数据集），原文未做跨方法可解释性对照；只能各自陈述其主张"}],"answer":"RoG 把关系路径当作受知识图谱约束的计划：先由规划模块生成关系路径作为“faithful plans”，再从 KG 中检索有效推理路径供 LLM 推理，从而“retrieve the latest knowledge from KGs but also consider the guidance of KG structure for reasoning and explanations” [E1]；形式上以生成关系路径 z 的计划概率与给定 z、G 的答案概率相乘来刻画 [E6]；并称该框架生成“faithful and interpretable reasoning results” [E3]。MindMap 则以提示流程让 LLM 理解 KG 输入并“consolidates the retrieved facts from KGs and the implicit knowledge from LLMs”、在输入 KG 中发现新模式、再在 mind map 上推理 [E2]；其所谓 mind map 是“reveals their reasoning pathways based on the ontology of knowledge” [E7]，结论称可借图表示的 rationale 生成答案 [E9]。因此隐式知识在 MindMap 中被显式纳入与外部 KG 事实结合的推理 [E2]，而 RoG 的表述侧重将 KG 结构蒸馏进 LLM 以生成受图约束的计划、再检索路径推理 [E1]；MindMap 还主张让 LLM 同时利用外部与隐式知识可获更准确答案，并批评纯检索方法可能过度依赖外部知识 [E4]。可解释性边界：RoG 的“faithful and interpretable”是在其两个 KGQA 基准实验条件下得出的主张 [E1]；MindMap 的透明性主张来自三个医疗 Q&A 数据集及不匹配 KG 知识设定下的实验 [E9, E10]。原文未提供二者在相同数据划分、底座模型与解释质量协议下的对照，故不能据此断言一方解释更可信或二者结论可互相外推；两文亦未给出统一的“可解释性”度量定义 [E4, E10]。","citations":[{"eid":"E1","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E6","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E3","quote_id":"q2"},{"eid":"E2","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E7","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E9","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E4","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E10","quote_id":"q1"}],"status":"partial"}
